overview: A WhatsApp automation dashboard for managing campaigns, contacts, and simulated WhatsApp clients with real-time polling.
features: Dashboard with live stats and client status grid
WhatsApp client manager with mock QR code connection flow
Contacts management with CSV import, search, and bulk delete
Campaign creation with delay slider, message templates, and progress tracking
Message history with filters, CSV export, and pagination
Group contact extractor with save-to-list functionality
Purple/violet accent theme with gradient hero banner
